text: Computer science and technology focuses on computer systems as its core research object, exploring the laws of information representation, processing, storage and transmission. It integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as mathematics, electronic engineering, and logic, and is both a highly theoretical basic discipline and a highly practical engineering discipline. Core objective: To address the issue of "how to efficiently process and utilize data" in the information age, including designing more powerful computer hardware, developing more intelligent software systems, and constructing more secure information networks, etc.Academic status: It is the fundamental support for emerging fields such as digital economy, artificial intelligence, and the Internet of Things, and is hailed as the "cornerstone of the information age".
